Accused denied the prosecution case in its entirety and claimed innocence and submitted that he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
Despite opportunity, no independent evidence was led by the accused in his defence.
Sh. Jai Kishan Saxena who was the then Kanoongo, SDM Office and conducted demarcation proceedings, was also examined as PW-11 by the prosecution and he proved the original report before the Court.

48. Since accused has failed to rebut any of the allegation made by the Prosecution, all the ingredients of Section 447 are made out against him.
Further, Prosecution has alleged that accused had illegally FIR No: 4/1997 State Vs. Manoj Kumar Gupta Page No. 37 of 40 constructed a four storey building on the trespassed land and induced victims to purchase them against consideration.
